A '''paleontologist''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]<ref name="Yuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Yuna Bore Venom Mine}}</ref> practicing [[paleontology]],<ref name="Mindharp">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> which involved studying [[Species/Legends|species]] of prehistoric creatures.<ref name="Yuna" /> By [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date KotET">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] take place in [[3630 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "Fossil Records" is part of the ''Knights of the Eternal Throne'' expansion and therefore also takes place in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> paleontologists had established a camp near the large fossil beds on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Noe'ha'on/Legends|Noe'ha'on]].<ref name="Fossil Records">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Fossil Records}}</ref>
